response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS analysed_trade_records FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, analysed_trade_records, 1.0 * analysed_trade_records / SUM(analysed_trade_records) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts ORDER BY trader_type;
